python3 -c "
import sys, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

# Set up PYTHONPATH
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('src')))

import yaml
from gov import store
from gov.retrieval import lexical, semantic
from gov.retrieval.retrieve import retrieve

REPO_ROOT = Path('.').resolve()
DEV_TIERS = Path(os.path.expanduser('~/gov-os-workbench/synthetic'))

queries = yaml.safe_load((DEV_TIERS / 'dev-queryset.yaml').read_text())['queries']
baseline_path = Path('src/gov/retrieval/retrieve_baseline.yaml')
baseline = yaml.safe_load(baseline_path.read_text())

tiers_map = {'A': 'a-dev', 'B': 'b-dev'}

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    roots = {}
    for programme, tier_name in tiers_map.items():
        tier_path = DEV_TIERS / tier_name
        if not (tier_path / '.git').exists():
            continue
        dest = Path(tmpdir) / tier_name
        subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '-q', '--no-hardlinks', str(tier_path), str(dest)], capture_output=True)
        
        # Adopt: explicit namespace fields matching support.adopt()
        path_map_path = REPO_ROOT / 'governance/project/path-map.yaml'
        document = yaml.safe_load(path_map_path.read_text())
        document['namespaces'] = {'everything': {
            'paths': ['**'], 'memory_class': 'governance',
            'sensitivity': 'internal',
            'permitted_roles': ['orchestrator', 'product-spec', 'independent-test-designer', 'engineer',
                                'independent-auditor', 'research'],
            'retention': 'kept in git history', 'export_policy': 'allowed',
            'provenance': 'check', 'deletion_rebuild': 'authoritative; restored from git only',
            'embedding_policy': 'embedded',
        }}
        (dest / 'governance/project').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (dest / 'governance/project/path-map.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(document, sort_keys=False))
        config_src = REPO_ROOT / 'template/.gitleaks.toml'
        if config_src.is_file():
            shutil.copy2(config_src, dest / '.gitleaks.toml')
        exclude = dest / '.git/info/exclude'
        exclude.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(exclude, 'a') as fh:
            fh.write('\n.gov-runtime/\n')
        
        git_cmd = ['git', '-C', str(dest), '-c', 'user.name=check', '-c', 'user.email=check@check']
        subprocess.run([*git_cmd, 'add', '-A'], capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run([*git_cmd, 'commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'adopted'], capture_output=True)
        
        lexical.refresh(dest)
        try:
            semantic.refresh(dest)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'  semantic.refresh failed for {programme}: {e}', file=sys.stderr)
        try:
            store.load(dest)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'  store.load failed for {programme}: {e}', file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        roots[programme] = dest
    
    scored = {}
    forbidden_count = 0
    for entry in queries:
        programme = entry.get('programme', '')
        root = roots.get(programme)
        if root is None:
            continue
        question = entry.get('query', '')
        gold = entry.get('gold', {})
        must_cite = gold.get('must_cite', [])
        must_not_cite = gold.get('must_not_cite', [])
        cls = entry.get('class', 'default')
        try:
            bundle = retrieve(root, question, radius=3, batch_size=200, bundle_budget=1_000_000)
        except Exception as e:
            scored.setdefault(cls, []).append(False)
            print(f'MISS {entry[\"id\"]} ({cls}): EXCEPTION: {e}')
            continue
        cited = list(dict.fromkeys(item['path'] for item in bundle.get('evidence', [])))[:5]
        hit = bool(set(must_cite) & set(cited))
        scored.setdefault(cls, []).append(hit)
        if not hit:
            print(f'MISS {entry[\"id\"]} ({cls}): query={question[:60]}')
            print(f'  must_cite={must_cite[:3]}')
            print(f'  got      ={cited[:5]}')
        for p in must_not_cite:
            if p in cited:
                forbidden_count += 1

    per_class = {name: 100.0 * sum(hits) / len(hits) for name, hits in scored.items()}
    hit_at_5 = sum(per_class.values()) / len(per_class)
    print(f'\nhit@5: {hit_at_5:.1f} (baseline: {baseline[\"hit_at_5\"]})')
    print(f'forbidden: {forbidden_count} (baseline: {baseline[\"forbidden_citations\"]})')
    for name, pct in sorted(per_class.items()):
        print(f'  {name}: {pct:.1f}%')
" 2>&1
until [ -s .gov-runtime/scratch/lead/log/a2-engineer-r2.json ]; do sleep 30; done && echo "engineer done"
